semiconductor_relevance: High — Jiangsu Aricen Electronic Materials Co., Ltd. specializes in electronic chemicals and specialty gases essential for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Jiangsu Aricen Electronic Materials Co., Ltd. is a comprehensive service provider offering integrated gas-liquid solutions tailored for the semiconductor and photovoltaic industries. Established in 2010, the company is a key player in the production of electronic-grade chemicals and specialty gases, supporting various applications across the semiconductor value chain.

regional_presence.China: The company has multiple production bases in Jiangsu Province and other regions, enabling extensive service coverage across the Asia-Pacific.
regional_presence.Thailand: Manufacturing presence in Rayong Province to support regional demand.
regional_presence.Malaysia: Production facility in Sarawak to enhance service capabilities.
regional_presence.Cambodia: Manufacturing site in Sihanoukville to cater to local markets.
